E1272

`{count}` package refs lack a supported Nix compatibility output.

What

`{count}` package refs lack a supported Nix compatibility output.

Why

The listed refs need pinned compatibility outputs. Jetpack does not invoke an installed Nix executable for package realization, so native core and adapted packages can proceed while unsupported Nix refs are reported as holes.

Fix

Provide a pinned fixture or verified Hangar output, or replace the listed refs with native sources/adapters; `jetpack add <ref> --adapt` drafts an adapter snippet.
